ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 30 Oct 2026
points: Your site shows 9,586 reviews, yet only 3 of 28 ads carry a site review count, so buyers meet proof only after the click. Put 9,586 reviews on the creative and open two ads with a review quote.
Your site offers 20% off a first order, yet none of your 28 ads mention it. A new visitor has no reason to buy. Put the 20% first order offer in the first line of three ads and on the creative.

6 of 28 ads use claim words such as clinically, cure and guaranteed results, which limits reach. Swap them for what customers noticed, like the bass they feel, and open with the site quote “You’re not hearing it, you’re feeling it.”

13 different openings run across 28 ads, and the biggest opens 6 ads while the second opens 4. No single story gets built out enough to learn from. Keep the two best openings and build the next batch of six from them.
